title.narrative: Reintegration of children formerly associated with armed conflict (CAFAC)

description.narrative: 410 children were reintegrated into society and returned to school. 410 Parents economically empowered through vocational training. 60 members of a community committee have been trained to raise community awareness of the culture of children's rights and work to protect them. 20,012 indirect beneficiaries of the project.
Reintegration of children formerly associated with the armed conflict in the governorates of Ma’rib and Sayun city in the Republic of Yemen.

The overall objective of the project: the reintegration of children formerly associated with the armed conflict in the governorates of Marib and Sayun city in the Republic of Yemen. Sub-objectives: - Re-integration of children with their natural counterparts in society. Attracting children and their families, providing aid and supplies, and returning children to education seats. Empowering children's families economically through vocational training. - Establishing and training community committees concerned with monitoring the protection of children and spreading the culture of children's rights and working to protect them.
